name: Question 14
problem: A particle of mass $5\,\text{kg}$ is attached to a massless spring. The spring constant associated with the spring is $k=45\,{\text{kg/s}}^{2}.$  The particle is also subject to a resistive force that's proportional to the particle's speed and has a damping coefficient $c=20\,\text{kg/s}.$  The position of the particle is $y(t)$ (measured in meters) and $t>0$ is the time in seconds.  If the particle moves with damped harmonic motion, what is the governing equation?

A particle of mass 5kg is attached to a massless spring. The spring constant associated with the spring is k=45kg/s2. The particle is also subject to a resistive force that's proportional to the particle's speed and has a damping coefficient c=20kg/s. The position of the particle is y(t) (measured in meters) and t>0 is the time in seconds. If the particle moves with damped harmonic motion, what is the governing equation?

y″+4y′+9y=0
b
y″+2y′+y=0
c
y″+2y′+3y=0
d
y″+4y′+3y=0

y″+y′+9y=0
